events.description: This Diwali, we're celebrating the big-hearted way — with music, food, and art from our own Bay Area South Asian community!! Come out to enjoy and support the roots of south asian culture and music that pervades the peninsula! Dilwale Diwali brings together up-and-coming South Asian indie artists for a night of live music, alongside local vendors slinging desi comfort food (mango lassi included, obviously) and South Asian makers showing off their art. Come dressed to shine, bring your people, and let's light this one up together. ✨ What to expect: 🎶 Live sets from Bay Area South Asian indie artists 🥭 Desi snacks (including mango lassi on deck!) 🎨 South Asian art + makers 🪔 Warm community! $12 advance $15 day of show 6:30 PM Doors 7:00 PM Music

events.title: Thirst Draft: Write Drunk, Edit Never

artists.name: Thirst Draft: Write Drunk, Edit Never

events.description: An event for writers — and for writing. Everyone gets the same prompt when they walk in the door. What ends up on the page is up to you! Here’s how it works: Write whatever you want — poem, song, short story, joke… anything works! Interpret the prompt however you like, but try to incorporate it in some way Work alone or collaborate with friends/strangers — no word count or time limit Sign up by 7pm if you want to share your piece on stage, just like an open mic Want to join, but can’t make it by 6 pm? All good! Here are some loose times to keep in mind: Write & Mingle: 6pm to 7pm Share on Stage: 7pm to 8pm Drink & Discuss: 8pm to 9pm No cover, no editing, no AI. Pens and paper will be available, but bring your own if you can. Grab a drink (or an NA beverage!), tip your bartenders, and support your fellow writers.

events.title: Sonamó + DJ Nino MSK
events.description: San Francisco’s funkiest “little room / big show” night is back. Sonamó turns Madrone into a full-throttle, late-night dance floor—the kind of night where the band plays like it’s a 1,000-person festival… even if you’re close enough to feel the bass in your ribs. Sonamó Live brings Italian backbone + global grooves + Bay Area funk energy, then we hand the room to our partner in crime DJ Nino MSK for an all-vinyl DJ set that keeps the party spinning until the end. Come for the show. Stay for the wax. 🕘 9:00 PM Doors 🎶 9:30 PM Sonamó (Live) 💿 11:30 PM DJ Nino MSK (All-Vinyl DJ Set) 💵 $5 at the door 📀 Eclectic Radio vinyl available at the merch table Bring your crew. Dress however you dance. Just don’t show up “for a quick one.” That’s how they get you.
